# Contributing to Jamf Device Checker

Thanks for your interest in Jamf Device Checker!

## This repository has no source code

Jamf Device Checker is a closed-source app distributed exclusively through the Apple App Store. This repository exists as a public hub for:

- **Documentation** — guides, FAQs, and release notes live in the [Wiki](../../wiki)
- **Bug reports** — [file a bug](../issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) if something isn't working as expected
- **Feature requests** — [suggest a feature](../issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) you'd like to see
- **Questions** — [ask a question](../issues/new?template=general_question.yml) if you need help

## How to contribute

### Reporting issues
Use the issue templates — they help us triage and respond faster. Please search [existing issues](../issues) before opening a new one.

### Improving documentation
If you spot an error or gap in the docs, open an issue describing what should be changed, or open a pull request editing the relevant page in the `wiki/` folder of this repo.

### Code contributions
The app source is not hosted here. If you are a Jamf employee looking to contribute to the codebase, refer to internal development guidelines.

## Code of Conduct

Be respectful and constructive. Issues or comments that are abusive or off-topic will be closed.
